approach.name: Practical
approach.description: Services and how to book up front; getting in touch is never more than a tap away.

pages.label: Your page
pages.approach: Services and how to book up front; getting in touch is never more than a tap away.

sections.label: Top bar
sections.intent: The business name or logo in thick monospace, short links to services, how it works, work and contact, and a bold WhatsApp button so any visitor can reach the owner in one tap; collapses to name plus button on phones
sections.layout: Single row inside a heavy bottom border, name left, links centre, boxed call button right

sections.label: What we do
sections.intent: The profession set large in raw monospace with the business name beneath and one clear contact button, so clients of any trade instantly know what this is and how to ask
sections.layout: Typographic hero: oversized type filling the width, hard-edged button below on a plain background

sections.label: Services and prices
sections.intent: Each service the owner offers with a short line and its price, up front so visitors can decide quickly before getting in touch
sections.layout: Bento grid with one large tile for the main service and smaller bordered tiles around it

sections.label: How to book
sections.intent: Three plain steps from message to visit to done, so first-time clients know exactly what happens when they reach out
sections.layout: Three equal columns with thin dividers, big numerals at top of each

sections.label: Call strip
sections.intent: A quick reminder that a call or WhatsApp is all it takes, keeping contact a tap away mid-page
sections.layout: Edge-to-edge marquee strip in the brand colour with light text and a repeating 'Call / WhatsApp' line

sections.label: Recent work
sections.intent: Pictures of real jobs, products or results the owner fills in, to show the quality behind the prices
sections.layout: Carousel of large pictures with captions overlaid bottom-left inside thick frames

sections.label: Kind words
sections.intent: Short quotes from local clients with their names, so newcomers trust the work before booking
sections.layout: Cards that overlap slightly, offset vertically, each with a heavy border and drop shadow

sections.label: Quick questions
sections.intent: Answers on areas served, timings, payment and visits, clearing doubts that stop people from enquiring
sections.layout: Asymmetric 7/5 grid: accordion on the wide side, a short note and WhatsApp link on the narrow side

sections.label: Get in touch
sections.intent: The enquiry form beside phone, WhatsApp, email, address, hours and a map link, so any client can book the way they prefer
sections.layout: Centered card floating over a tinted background, form left and contact details right within the card

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Name, one warm line, contact, social links and the year to close the page simply
sections.layout: Band in the brand colour with light monospace text split into stacked rows
